claude_proposed_widenings.name: reactive_passive_magic_item_component
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines an always-on passive bonus with a standing reaction rider that is not use-count- or reset-based. Current MagicItemMechanics can compose passive and activated parts, but not a trigger-shaped passive component that only spends the reaction quota when its trigger occurs.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a Reaction...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_forced_movement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rider does not create movement; it reduces an incoming forced-movement distance by up to a cap. Existing atoms like force_move and modify_speed do not model intercepting another effect's movement payload.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.
